model: Levered FCFE DCF at cost of equity (engine route; SOE borrowings treated as operating funding, net debt held at zero)

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: revenue_3yr_cagr (FY2022-FY2025); equity CAGR rejected as the base because book grows from retained earnings while earnings fall (ROE 9% -> 5%)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity CAGR +5.4%/+6.0% diverges by >30% from EPS CAGR -12.5%/-3.9% and revenue 3yr -2.1%: book value is compounding from retained accrual earnings and perpetual issuance while per-share earnings and cash conversion deteriorate. Book growth is not a valid growth proxy here.
historical_growth.notes: FCF CAGRs undefined: reported FCF (OCF - capex) was negative in FY2018, FY2021, FY2023, FY2024, FY2025 and H1 FY2026 (-103.6bn). SBC is zero so owner FCF equals reported FCF. Cumulative FY2019-FY2023 OCF of RMB 149bn covered only ~62% of net income + D&A (~239bn); FY2024-FY2025 OCF of -28bn against ~100bn of NI + D&A. Working capital (receivables 241bn, contract assets 374bn at FY2025, both growing while revenue falls) is where the earnings are going.

scenario_narratives.base: Domestic construction output keeps falling through FY2026 (revenue -10% after H1 -12.4%) and bottoms in FY2028 as already-budgeted special and ultra-long treasury bonds are deployed and overseas work (7% of revenue, growing double digits) compounds; thereafter revenue grows ~2% nominal, below Chinese nominal GDP. The post-interest margin holds at 5.3% in FY2026 (ordinary EPS ~0.98, -17%) and recovers to 5.5% on the cost programme and falling PBOC rates, never regaining the FY2022-23 level. Capex glides from 4.8% of revenue back toward D&A (3.0%) as management shifts from investment-driven construction to return-focused investment; working capital neither releases nor absorbs further cash. The debt stock is held flat so the ~RMB 4bn dividend has to be earned, not borrowed, from year 3.
scenario_narratives.bull: Belt & Road and the strategic-emerging-industry push offset the domestic decline faster than expected: revenue troughs at -8% in FY2026 and returns to 3% growth by year 5. Cost cuts, overseas mix and ~2% SOE funding lift the post-interest margin to 6.0%. The Q4-2025 minority buy-out and lower rates cut leakage to 37%. Capex normalises to D&A by year 5, and the receivables/contract-asset pile partially unwinds as local-government debt swaps settle arrears (5% release on the shrinking revenue). Exit still capped at 10x FCFE; the bull case does not assume a re-rating beyond that.
scenario_narratives.bear: The H1 FY2026 pattern is the new run-rate: construction output -12.7%, real estate investment -18%, new contracts -17%, and local governments continue to pay late or not at all. Revenue falls 13%, 9%, 6% and keeps shrinking; the margin erodes to 4.8% under 'stock competition'; capex cannot be cut below ~4-5% because BOT/PPP commitments are contractual; working capital absorbs 10% of each year's lost revenue. FCFE is negative for most of the decade, the dividend is borrowed, and the debt stock keeps rising -- which this model (debt held flat) translates into an equity value at or below zero. State support would keep CRCC solvent, but through recapitalisation that dilutes ordinary holders, so a value near zero is the honest reading of this path.

valuation_philosophy.summary: CRCC's ordinary equity is a thin, option-like residual on a RMB 800bn+ capital structure funded by state banks at ~2%. The only sensible way to value it is the flow that actually reaches ordinary shareholders -- post-interest, post-tax, post-NCI, post-perpetual earnings, plus D&A, less capex, less the working capital that the shrinking client base is absorbing -- discounted at a CNY cost of equity with net debt held at zero and the debt stock assumed flat. On that basis the market's ~3x P/E and 8% yield are not obviously cheap: FY2025 reported FCF was -RMB 44.6bn, FY0 FCFE on the model's own definition was about -RMB 4bn before working capital, and every unit of value in the base and bull cases comes from capex normalising toward D&A and collections stabilising. The equity is worth something materially above the H-share price only if the business can stop consuming cash; the bear case, which is simply the H1 FY2026 run-rate extended, puts it at or below zero. No-re-rate memo: the base terminal (10x FCFE cap, Gordon 11.2x) is ~2-3x the H-share's own decade-long 3-6x P/E range; at a 5x exit the base value would be roughly 25-30% lower.
key_risks_to_valuation: Working-capital absorption continues (receivables +18%, contract assets +23% in FY2025 while revenue fell): the base case credits no further drain, the bear case charges 10% of lost revenue; the H1 FY2026 outflow of RMB 79bn exceeds both
Capex does not normalise: FY2025 47.6bn (4.6% of revenue) and H1 FY2026 24.7bn are both records; contractual BOT/PPP commitments may hold it near 5%
Debt stock is assumed flat; if borrowing keeps rising to fund the dividend and working capital, the equity is being diluted by creditors in substance even without issuance
Perpetual-bond coupons (~RMB 2.4bn) and NCI leakage are fixed charges that take a rising share of a shrinking PBT
Terminal multiple: a 10x FCFE exit on a leveraged SOE contractor in a structurally declining market is generous against the H-share's historical 3-6x P/E; the no-re-rate value is ~25-30% below base
Discount rate: cost of equity 10% in CNY; the H-share's 39% discount to the A-share says the Hong Kong market demands more than that
Impairment of real-estate inventory, contract assets and receivables (RMB 5.1bn credit losses in FY2025) could step up if local-government fiscal stress deepens
Q3 FY2026 results (~2026-11-04) are the next anchor; a further revenue or cash-flow deterioration moves year-1 drivers toward the bear path

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of; 52-week range 4.23-5.70 HKD. A-share 601186.SS and CNYHKD=X fetched at the same time for the parity note.
data_sources.financials: 1186.HK_Metrics.csv / core_metrics (FY2017-FY2025 annual, H1 FY2026 interim); 1186.HK_Annual_FY2025.txt (interest income line 14084, D&A line 31362, net debt line 25780, NCI line 14047); 1186.HK_HalfYear_H1-2026.txt (balance sheet lines 8019-8085: short-term loans, long-term loans, bonds payable, lease liabilities, other equity instruments 72,322,256, non-controlling interests 90,919,088; current-portion notes lines 16397-16399; restricted cash line 12997). Figures in the filings are RMB thousands, converted to millions.
data_sources.qualitative: 1186.HK_Analysis.json (2026-10-16): business model, risks, H1 FY2026 developments, guidance (qualitative only).

inputs.sbc_source: SBC-zero market: PRC-GAAP central SOE with no share-based payment scheme; StockBasedComp = 0 in FY2025 core_metrics. House and street bases coincide; band_position is null by construction.
inputs.fx_note: CNY->HKD 1.1728 (Yahoo CNYHKD=X, 2026-10-16, same fetch as the price). All flows and per-share values are built in RMB and converted to HKD at this rate for the unsuffixed intrinsic_value / weighted_iv; *_cny twins carry the model currency. Dual-listing parity check is NOT a tie: the A-share 601186.SS traded at RMB 6.16 (= HK$7.22 at 1.1728) at the same time, so the H-share stood at a ~39% discount to the A-share. That is the standard A/H premium on SOE H-shares, not an FX-direction error; the H-share price in current_price is the one this valuation is compared to.
inputs.share_count_basis: 13,579.542m shares (A + H), flat since 2017; no options, convertibles or share schemes; the RMB 72.3bn of perpetual bonds in 'other equity instruments' are non-convertible and are charged as a cash leakage in the flows, not as dilution. Held FLAT.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Discount rate is a CNY COST OF EQUITY, not a WACC, because the flows are post-interest FCFE. 10-year CGB ~1.8% + China ERP 6.5% x levered beta 1.25 (equity is a ~7% slice of a ~RMB 800bn capital structure) = 9.9%, rounded to 10.0%. Applied identically to all three scenarios: cyclicality, collection risk and capex discipline are charged in the flows via the scenarios, not stacked into the rate (risk charged once).
inputs.lease_treatment: (B) leases as operating cost: lease principal + interest (~RMB 2.6bn/yr, current portion of lease liabilities RMB 2.15bn at 30-Jun-2026 plus interest) charged inside the post-interest margin as lease_cost_pct_path 0.25% of revenue; da_pct_path is D&A EX right-of-use depreciation (~RMB 25.4bn of 27.8bn FY2025 = 2.5%, rising as a % as revenue shrinks); lease liabilities (RMB 8.0bn) excluded from the (zero) net debt.
inputs.nci_treatment: Charged ONCE, in the flows: the engine's cash_tax_rate_path is a combined leakage rate on pre-tax profit = income tax (~20%) + non-controlling interests' share (~12% FY2025, ~7% H1 FY2026 after the RMB 11bn Q4-2025 minority buy-out) + perpetual-bond distributions (~RMB 2.3-2.4bn/yr, ~9-11% of PBT). FY2025 calibration: PBT 26,933 x (1-0.405) = 16,020 = ordinary EPS 1.18 x 13,579.5m shares. No NCI or perpetual deduction in the bridge.
inputs.notes: MODEL: levered FCFE DCF at a CNY cost of equity, run through the owner-FCF engine with net_debt = 0. WHY NOT UNLEVERED: CRCC's ordinary equity (~RMB 51bn at the H-share price) sits behind RMB 577bn of net borrowings, RMB 72bn of perpetuals and RMB 91bn of NCI, funded by state banks at ~2.3% (FY2025 interest expense 13.1bn on ~560bn average debt). Unlevered FCF before working capital is ~RMB 12bn/yr, so EV minus RMB 740bn of prior claims is the difference of two huge numbers and its sign flips on half a point of WACC; the skill's bank rule (deposits are operating funding, not net debt) applies by analogy. HOW THE ENGINE IS MAPPED: ebitda_margin_path is a POST-INTEREST margin = (profit before tax + D&A ex-ROU + lease cost) / revenue (FY2025: 26,933 + 25,400 + 2,600 = 54,900 = 5.33%); the engine's EBIT therefore equals PBT; cash_tax_rate_path is the combined tax + NCI + perpetual leakage (see nci_treatment); NOPAT equals ordinary-shareholder earnings; D&A is added back, capex (RMB 47.6bn FY2025, 4.6% of revenue; H1 FY2026 24.7bn, still rising) deducted; working capital is charged on the change in revenue via wc_capture_pct. Net borrowing is assumed ZERO (debt stock flat): capex and working capital must be funded from earnings, which is the conservative FCFE convention and the opposite of what the company has actually done since FY2023 (debt +RMB 395bn). INTEREST INCOME retained in the flows (matching-asset rule): cash is operating funding netted inside the zero net debt, so its RMB 3.9bn of income stays in PBT. CASH BASIS: 150,804 is cash and cash equivalents; the 168,252 'cash and bank balances' KPI includes ~RMB 11.2bn restricted and other balances. FY0 is FY2025 (last full year); balance-sheet anchors are 30-Jun-2026 (H1 FY2026 interim). No quantified FY2026 guidance exists (SOE practice): H1 FY2026 revenue -12.4%, attributable NI -18.8%, ordinary EPS -21% (0.55 vs 0.70), new contracts -17%; Q3 FY2026 results due ~2026-11-04 and are the next anchor refresh. DIVIDEND: FY2025 RMB 0.30/share (25.5% payout) = 8.0% yield at the H-share price, currently funded by borrowing (FY2025 reported FCF -44.6bn). REPORTED vs MODEL FCF: last_fcf is the reported FY2025 OCF - capex (-44,644); on the model's own definition FY0 FCFE before working capital was ~ -3.8bn (16.0 ordinary earnings + 27.8 D&A - 47.6 capex), i.e. the company is not currently generating cash for shareholders, and every scenario's value depends on capex normalising toward D&A and on collections stabilising. NO-RE-RATE MEMO: the H-share has traded at ~3-6x P/E for a decade; the base terminal (10x FCFE cap / Gordon 11.2x) assumes a modest re-rating; see valuation_philosophy.

bear.note: The H1 FY2026 trajectory continues: domestic construction keeps contracting, margin erodes to 4.8% (PBT margin 1.75%), capex stays above D&A, and working capital ABSORBS 10% of each year's revenue decline (clients stretch payment as the industry shrinks; positive wc_capture on a negative revenue change is an outflow). Leakage 42% as fixed perpetual coupons weigh on a smaller PBT. Exit capped at 8x.

base.margin_note: Post-interest margin (PBT + D&A ex-ROU + lease cost)/revenue. FY2025 5.33%; FY2026 5.3% implies PBT ~RMB 21.8bn (-19%, in line with H1 -21%) and ordinary EPS ~0.98. Recovers to 5.5% (PBT margin 2.55% vs 2.62% FY2025, 3.4% FY2022-23) on cost cuts, overseas mix and falling finance costs.
base.capex_note: 4.8% in FY2026 (H1 annualises >5%), glides to 3.0% by year 7 as management's 'return-focused investment' replaces investment-driven construction; terminal net capex ~0.3% of revenue above D&A.
base.wc_note: wc_capture 0: no working-capital release credited on the revenue decline (collections have not released cash as revenue fell), and no further structural absorption charged beyond FY2026. Base assumes OCF converges on earnings + D&A over the horizon.
base.leakage_note: 39% = income tax ~20% + NCI ~7-8% (post Q4-2025 buy-out) + perpetual distributions ~RMB 2.4bn (~11% of a ~22bn PBT).

bull.note: Overseas (+94% 9M2025 new contracts) and special-bond deployment return revenue to growth from year 3; margin to 6.0% (PBT margin 3.05%, still below FY2022-23); capex back to D&A by year 5; working capital releases 5% of each year's revenue decline and absorbs 5% of growth.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 10x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 35% from the 15% default because the bear path is the CURRENT trajectory, not a hypothetical: debt has risen RMB 395bn in 2.5 years, OCF was -79bn in H1 FY2026, capex is still rising and management lists 'debt and funding risk' as a top-five risk. Base 45% because the stabilisation it needs (bond deployment, overseas growth, capex normalisation) is policy-backed and already budgeted. Bull cut to 20% because it requires several independent things to go right at once (overseas growth, margin recovery, capex discipline AND a working-capital unwind).
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
